headlines.title: Arm Just Dropped 21% in a Month. Will ARM Stock Hit $150 or $200 First?
headlines.summary: Arm has shed a fifth of its value in a month, leaving bulls and bears staring at two very different price levels. A stretched valuation, defensive options bets, and a surprisingly strong pipeline all collide in the fight over where shares head next.

headlines.title: Who Is Rene Haas? What to Know About the Arm CEO as Nvidia Searches for Jensen Huang's Successor
headlines.summary: Hendrick & Struggles, the firm Nvidia hired to help it find a successor for Jensen Huang, has reportedly approached Arm’s Rene Haas. Haas already has experience with Nvidia.

headlines.title: Nvidia reportedly approaches Arm CEO Rene Haas in search for Jensen Huang successor
headlines.summary: Nvidia Corp (NASDAQ:NVDA, XETRA:NVD) has reportedly approached Arm Holdings chief executive Rene Haas as a potential successor to Jensen Huang, as the artificial intelligence (AI) chipmaker searches for permanent leadership following the former chief executive’s departure.

headlines.title: Nvidia Could Poach Arm's CEO to Replace Jensen Huang. Here's What That Might Mean for ARM Stock.
headlines.summary: Nvidia's CEO search reaches Arm's Rene Haas. Here's what ARM investors need to know.

headlines.title: Arm CEO Rene Haas Reportedly Approached By Recruitment Agency Hired By Nvidia Board
headlines.summary: Hass appreciated Huang’s leadership at Nvidia during a technology conference in Austin.

description: Arm Holdings plc researches, develops, licenses, and markets central processing unit (CPU) intellectual property (IP), graphics processing unit IP, systems IP, compute subsystems (CSS), and associated software, tools and related services. The company provides a product portfolio, including CPU IP, GPU and neural processing unit (NPU) accelerators, system IP such as interconnects, compute platform products including pre-integrated CSSs, and development tools and software. The company serves semiconductor companies, original equipment manufacturers (OEMs), cloud service providers (CSPs), and organizations developing chips for end markets such as smartphones, consumer electronics, industrial IoT, embedded systems, cloud data centers, networking, automotive, and robotics. It provides its products and services in the United States, China, Japan, Taiwan, Korea, and internationally. The company was founded in 1990 and is based in Cambridge, United Kingdom. Arm Holdings plc operates as a subsidiary of SoftBank Group Corp.
